groups.name: usb_in
groups.why: USB-C receptacle (west edge) with its CC1/CC2 5k1 pull-downs at the CC pins and the 33R D-/D+ series pair; the pair borders core (PA11/PA12)

groups.name: power
groups.why: AMS1117-3.3 LDO from VBUS: C1 10nF + C2 10uF on its VI (+5V), C3 10uF on VO (+3.3V, the LDO's required output cap and the only 3.3V bulk cap)

groups.name: core
groups.why: STM32F103CB with its 8MHz crystal and 20pF load caps, NRST pull-up R2 + cap C4, BOOT0 and PC13 pull-downs R3/R4, the PA0 4k7/4k7 strap divider R9/R10, the USB-side 18pF caps C7/C9 and the 1k5 D+ pull-up R15 at PA11/PA12; R5 100R series from PB12 (the SWDIO driver) onto TGT_SWDIO, at the driver pin

groups.name: debug
groups.why: 1x04 vertical SWD header that programs the STM32 itself (PA13/PA14); a short vertical header, no edge rule

groups.name: target
groups.why: target-side right-angle SMT headers on the east edge, opposite the USB end: J3 (F.Cu) target SWD/RST, J2 (B.Cu) target UART

groups.name: reset
groups.why: target reset button (north edge) with the TGT_RST 10k pull-up and 10nF cap beside it

groups.name: leds
groups.why: three status LEDs (G/B on PB5/PB6 sinking, R on PA9 sourcing) each with its series resistor
